comment: Overrides for scripts/swiftpm-notices.py, which build-deb.sh runs to write usr/share/doc/llimit/Third-Party-Notices.txt. The llimit binary has no SwiftPM pins; these are the libraries the Swift static Linux SDK links into it. SWIFT_SDK_SBOM is the installed SDK's sbom.spdx.json and SWIFT_LICENSE the toolchain's LICENSE.txt, both set by build-deb.sh. Every SDK package must be a component with the SBOM's version or skipped with a reason, so an SDK bump fails until the texts here are updated. Keep components.json in step.
preamble: LLimit's own code is released under the Unlicense (its text is in the
copyright file next to this file). The llimit binary is built with the Swift
static Linux SDK, which links the components below into it. They keep their
own licenses. The SDK's curl 8.7.1 reports itself as libcurl/8.7.0-DEV: it
is built from curl's git tag curl-8_7_1, which keeps the development version

spdx_sbom.reason: A new or bumped SDK component must fail the build until its notice is added.

skip.Swift statically linked SDK for Linux: The SDK bundle itself; its code is the Swift runtime and the libraries listed here.
skip.libxml2: Linked only through FoundationXML, which no LLimit module imports. static-runtime-notices.py finds no libxml2 in the binary and fails the build if that changes.

components.name: Swift standard library, Foundation and libdispatch
components.reason: The SDK's Swift runtime, swift-corelibs-foundation, swift-foundation and libdispatch. The Runtime Library Exception waives attribution; listed for completeness.

components.name: ICU (swift-foundation-icu)
components.reason: Foundation links lib_FoundationICU (icudt74l in the binary), which the Swift exception does not cover. swift-foundation-icu reports ICU 74.1 at swift-6.2.3-RELEASE; Swift 6.3 and 6.4 ship 76.1, so recheck when the Swift release changes.

components.name: curl
components.reason: FoundationNetworking links libcurl. The SBOM says MIT; curl's own license is the SPDX id curl.

components.name: BoringSSL
components.reason: The SDK's libcurl uses BoringSSL for TLS.

components.name: zlib
components.reason: Linked through libcurl; the binary carries zlib's inflate 1.3.1 copyright string.

components.name: musl-fts
components.reason: Foundation's directory enumeration uses fts, which musl takes from musl-fts.
